name: Socialinsider
description:
Socialinsider brings your social media analytics into Claude. Connect your account and ask about performance in plain language — Claude pulls the real numbers and does the analysis. Covers Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X.

What you can ask:

"How did our Instagram perform last month?" Followers, engagement rate, reach and impressions across the period, plus aggregate post metrics, the format mix, and the posts that actually worked.

"Compare us to our two main competitors on TikTok over the last 90 days." A side-by-side benchmark ranked by engagement rate rather than raw totals, so follower count doesn't decide the winner.

"Did our spring launch campaign work?" Claude matches the campaign tag, counts every tagged post across all profiles, and measures campaign engagement against the account's own baseline.

Capabilities:

Daily profile analytics — followers, engagement rate, reach, impressions
Aggregate post metrics — totals, averages, engagement rate, breakdown by post type
Top posts ranked by engagement, reach, impressions, video views, likes, comments or shares
Post counts across a whole project, filtered by campaign or content pillar
Individual posts with per-post metrics
Instagram Stories for owned, authorised business accounts
Campaign and content-pillar lookup with fuzzy name matching
Project, brand and profile management

Analytics tools are read-only. Tools that modify your account — creating projects or brands, adding or removing tracked profiles — are marked as such, and Claude states exactly what will change and waits for your confirmation before calling them.

Requires a Socialinsider account with analytics access. Sign-in happens through OAuth in your browser; there is no API key to copy or paste.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Socialinsider to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Socialinsider to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.socialinsider.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Socialinsider MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Socialinsider lists 19 MCP tools, including socialinsider_add_profile, socialinsider_add_profile_to_brand, socialinsider_count_posts, socialinsider_create_brand, socialinsider_create_project, socialinsider_create_project_with_brands, socialinsider_get_date_context, socialinsider_get_instagram_stories, socialinsider_get_posts, socialinsider_get_posts_summary, socialinsider_get_profile_data, and socialinsider_get_top_posts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Socialinsider?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Socialinsider in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Socialinsider requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Socialinsider is developed by Socialinsider. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
